scripts.model: if ! command -v souther >/dev/null; then echo 'souther is not on the PATH. Install it: see README.md' >&2; exit 1; fi; souther compile --target wasm model -o public/cart.wasm && souther-wasm-bindings public/cart.wasm -o src/cart.ts
scripts.build: npm run model && tsc --noEmit && vite build
